(Women) }} '''Empoli Football Club''' is an [[Italy|Italian]] professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Empoli]], [[Tuscany]]. Founded in 1920, the side is part of a select group of Italian football clubs not based in a provincial capital city that have participated in [[Serie A]].{{cite web|url=http://www.empolicalcio.net/Storia-1920-1930.htm|title=1920–1929|publisher=empolicalcio.net|access-date=8 November 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141108175624/http://www.empolicalcio.net/Storia-1920-1930.htm|archive-date=8 November 2014|url-status=dead}} Empoli has spent most of its history in professional football.{{cite web|url=http://www.empolicalcio.net/storia.htm |title=Storia |publisher=empolicalcio.net |access-date=8 November 2014 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006193256/http://www.empolicalcio.net/storia.htm |archive-date=6 October 2014}} Empoli competed in European competitions once, in which they were eliminated in the qualification stage of [[2007–08 UEFA Cup]].{{cite web|url=http://www.empolicalcio.net/2000-2009.htm|title=2000–2009|publisher=empolicalcio.net|access-date=8 November 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924000252/http://www.empolicalcio.net/2000-2009.htm|archive-date=24 September 2015|url-status=dead}}"}}
